description: Server, updates and managed policy of xlsft`s harness. Generated from packages/client/settings/policy.schema.json by scripts/policy-templates.sh. Don't edit it here: change the schema and run the script.

allowManagedHooksOnly.description: Only the hooks of policies run.
allowManagedHooksOnly.title: Only managed hooks

allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly.description: Permission rules from user, project and local settings are ignored.
allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly.title: Only managed permission rules

allowedMcpServers.description: Only MCP servers with these names may be used, at any scope. An empty list allows none.
allowedMcpServers.title: Allowed MCP servers

allowedProviders.description: Only these providers (id or preset id) serve models. An empty list allows none.
allowedProviders.title: Allowed model providers

allowedSkills.description: Only skills of these names may run; "kit:*" names all of a plugin. An empty list allows none.
allowedSkills.title: Allowed skills

blockedMarketplaces.description: Plugin sources that are refused, in the same forms, checked first.
blockedMarketplaces.title: Blocked plugin sources

blockedSkills.description: Skills that may not run, checked before allowedSkills.
blockedSkills.title: Blocked skills

disableAllHooks.description: No hooks run, from any level.
disableAllHooks.title: Turn off hooks

disableExternalSkillSearch.description: No search of public skill directories.
disableExternalSkillSearch.title: No public skill search

disableLocalModels.description: Models running on this machine can't be used.
disableLocalModels.title: No local models

disablePersonalProviders.description: Users can't add or use their own model providers.
disablePersonalProviders.title: No personal providers

disableUpdates.description: The desktop app and `harness-client update` don't look for or install updates. Use it when you deploy new versions yourself, for example as a package through device management.
disableUpdates.title: Turn off updates

permissions.description: Permission rules and modes, in the settings syntax. Rules of every policy add up.

ask.description: Permission rules that always ask, e.g. Bash(git push *).
ask.title: Always ask

defaultMode.description: The mode new sessions start in.
defaultMode.title: Default permission mode

deny.description: Permission rules that are always denied, e.g. Read(./.env).
deny.title: Always denied

disableAutoMode.description: "disable": nobody can switch to auto mode.
disableAutoMode.title: Turn off auto mode

disabledModes.description: Permission modes nobody may use. The default mode can't be turned off.
disabledModes.title: Turned off modes

permissions.title: Permissions

remoteControl.description: false: sessions are never mirrored to the server for watching and control from the web.
remoteControl.title: Remote control

sandbox.description: The sandbox of the model's commands.

allowOutside.description: false: commands can't run outside the sandbox at all.
allowOutside.title: Allow commands outside the sandbox

enabled.description: true: the sandbox can't be turned off.
enabled.title: Require the sandbox

sandbox.title: Sandbox

serverUrl.description: The harness server this machine signs in to. The desktop app's sign-in screen uses it and can't change it, and `harness-client login` takes it when no URL is given.
serverUrl.title: Server URL

strictKnownMarketplaces.description: Plugins and marketplaces come only from these sources. An empty list allows none.
strictKnownMarketplaces.title: Allowed plugin sources

updateMirrorUrl.description: Where updates come from instead of GitHub: a folder with latest.json and one subfolder per release tag, as scripts/release/offline-bundle.sh makes it. Updates are still verified with the release key built into the app and the client.
updateMirrorUrl.title: Update mirror

webSearchMode.description: live, cached, or disabled for the WebSearch tool.
webSearchMode.title: Web search

title: xlsft`s harness (com.xlsft.harness)
